answer: Seed trust in a haven of long-vetted agents and let it flow only along paid work receipts, each edge carrying at most one unit per epoch, for a short horizon of four hops. A farm of 1,000 fake agents trading receipts among themselves still reaches the honest region through the few real clients it actually served: that canyon of attack edges caps the trust it can absorb, so adding more fakes splits the same small trickle into thinner rewards instead of buying more.
